lines: That was how I, having been dragged here by this unknown hostess... that is to say, by Shizuru, had now ended up in this new dilemma.
(Ugh... It's showing no signs of calming down... And for starters, this woman's body is too damn sexy...)
For now I had to come up with something on the spot. Before she realized why I couldn't stand up.
B-By the way, Shizuru. Why did you help me?
Because I don't like those guys.
Those guys? Do you know the people who were chasing me?
Yes, of course. They're local yakuza gangsters... Mercenaries hired by those gangsters, to be exact.
Originally they were just a small local street gang, but after joining up with forces of darkness, they've been able to do whatever they want.
After they hired those monsters, they've been asking us for protection money even though we didn't ask to be protected, and also demanding free drinks and entertainment.
It was a story you often heard when a black market district was still developing.
But why were you being chased by them? You don't look like you live around here.
Ahh, yeah, I somehow got caught up in it...
I briefly explained what had happened.
...In short, it all happened because of those two demon brats.
Damn it, just thinking about it makes me angry... They were both short, had small tits, and acted like idiots... Do you know those two?
No, I don't... but sounds like something's up. Hmm... by the way, Fuma-kun?
No more buts! I didn't say anything because I didn't want to hurt your feelings, but you really smell like fish!!!
She was right. I had gotten used to it and had almost forgotten, but I still reeked of fish...
(But if I get up now, this robust physiological phenomenon will be exposed...)
Get in the bath right now! Come on!
I prepared myself for the worst and slowly stood up. Shizuru was still sitting on the bed... meaning her eyes were perfectly level with my waist...
Shizuru's eyes widened as she caught a glimpse of my impressive tent.
Whose fault do you think this is?! Of course this is going to happen when somebody dressed like that sits close by. Try to be a bit more careful!
That's right, it was all her fault. I took the offensive and protested.
Y-You're right. I'm the one responsible for this... hmm...
N-No... j-just go and wash up already...
Shizuru's eyes watered ever so slightly behind her glasses.
There was a strange feeling of tension in the air. I quickly headed for the bathroom as if to escape.
(That being said, it's not like taking a shower is going to remove the smell of Hebiko's octopus ink...)
I could only do my best to somehow hide it with the smell of soap, at least for a while. Besides, this smell could be useful in its own right.
(Something... nice is waiting for me after my shower♪)
That's right. She had made me feeling this way, so having her take a bit of responsibility was perfectly justifiable.
I washed my body with as much soap as possible, did my hair as best as I could, and returned to the room.
When I returned to the room there was no sign of Shizuru.
I started to get a bad feeling.
The sound of someone banging on the door and yelling with anger echoed through the room.
We know you're in there!! Do as you're told and come out!!
Did Shizuru sell me out to them?
(But then why did she save me in the first place?)
Would someone like her, a mere hostess, take such a risk just because she didn't like yakuza?
I don't understand this woman... But for now I have to do something about this predicament.
I took out my phone, sent Hebiko a quick message, and armed myself with a weapon for self-defense.
